answers.core:
> This is add-on to create realistic human skin and hairs (revised based on feedback)

One of the [main feedback Juan received](https://godotengine.org/article/godot-at-gdc-2023/) from his presence at [Game Developers Conference](https://gdconf.com/) (GDC), on March 20-24 2023 was that there is a strong demand for improving Godot4 rendering.

I think this is a strong justification for why such photo-realistic rendering needs to go into ONE of its Future Core Features.
